turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation of all 18 air-quality monitoring stations and clip each cell to the axis-aligned bounding box of all station coordinates. Use geodesic area (cast to geography) in km². Which station has the SMALLEST Voronoi cell, and what is its area (km², 1 dp)? Return the station name and area.
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

query = text("""
WITH stations AS (
  SELECT id, name_en, coordinate::geometry AS geom
  FROM air_quality_station
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakeEnvelope(
    MIN(ST_X(geom)), MIN(ST_Y(geom)),
    MAX(ST_X(geom)), MAX(ST_Y(geom))
  ), 4326) AS bbox
  FROM stations
),
vor AS (
  SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(
    ST_Collect(s.geom),
    0,
    ST_Expand(b.bbox, 1.0)
  ))).geom AS geom
  FROM stations s CROSS JOIN bounds b
),
cells AS (
  SELECT
    s.name_en,
    ST_Area(ST_Intersection(v.geom, b.bbox)::geography) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2
  FROM vor v
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  JOIN stations s ON ST_Covers(v.geom, s.geom)
),
summary AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_cells, MIN(area_km2) AS min_area, AVG(area_km2) AS avg_area, MAX(area_km2) AS max_area
  FROM cells
)
SELECT c.name_en, c.area_km2, s.n_cells, s.min_area, s.avg_area, s.max_area
FROM cells c CROSS JOIN summary s
ORDER BY c.area_km2 ASC
LIMIT 1;
""")

res = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
smallest_cell_station = str(res.loc[0, "name_en"])
smallest_cell_km2 = float(round(res.loc[0, "area_km2"], 1))

print(
    f"Computed Voronoi cells: {int(res.loc[0, 'n_cells'])}; "
    f"area range {res.loc[0, 'min_area']:.3f}-{res.loc[0, 'max_area']:.3f} km²; "
    f"smallest = {smallest_cell_station}, {smallest_cell_km2:.1f} km²"
)
